text: The property lost 25.5 hectares of tree cover in 2015 due to a significant tree-cover loss event. This event is confirmed by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13), which observed a loss of 25.5 hectares in that year. The European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset (GFC2020 V4) corroborates this by showing no forest cover in the area by 2020. The loss was not part of the claim interval but is part of the historical data observed by the tools.
